name: Doximity Scribe
one_liner: Free AI medical scribe for all verified US clinicians with 3M+ healthcare professionals on the Doximity network.
short_description: Doximity Scribe is a free AI-powered medical documentation tool that listens to patient visits and generates clinical notes for the 3M+ healthcare professionals on Doximity.
long_description: Doximity Scribe is an AI medical documentation assistant offered free to all US physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and medical students with a verified Doximity account. The tool listens securely during patient visits (in-person or telehealth) and drafts clinical notes in real-time, intelligently filtering clinically relevant content from casual conversation. Doximity Scribe supports multiple note formats including SOAP, H&P, Consult notes, and simple dictation, with the ability to create custom templates. Notes can be copied into any EHR—there's no native EHR integration. The platform is HIPAA-compliant and does not store or retain audio recordings. Doximity Scribe integrates with Doximity Ask (formerly DoxGPT) for note refinement and additional documentation like patient care instructions. Enterprise licensing is available separately for hospitals and health systems.
best_for: US clinicians wanting a free AI scribe with no monthly fees
Physicians already using Doximity for networking and communication
Practices comfortable with copy-paste EHR workflow
Medical students and residents needing documentation support
not_for: Clinicians needing deep native EHR integration
Organizations requiring enterprise features and SLAs
